name: two_speed_cooling_tower
title: Two-speed cooling tower (regimes and mean fan power vs water set-point)
summary: Evaporative cooling tower with a two-speed fan, each regime rated with the epsilon-NTU method on a fictitious dry fluid following the wet-bulb temperatures of the moist air; returns the outlet temperatures, heat rejected and weighted-mean fan powers for a given water outlet set-point.

authors: ULiège MSTh course (J. Lebrun, V. Lemort, S. Bertagnolio)
origin.course: ULiège MSTh, exercise session of 2005-10-24, exercise 2

verification.reference: Solution stored in the original EES file (~/Nextcloud/thermo_models/machines et systemes thermiques/MSTh - Repetitions/TP 06/MSTH051024EXERCICE2.EES, EES 7.458, candidate TM-0094)
verification.notes: 54/54 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001); largest deviation 7.1e-4 on omega_f_r/c_p_f_r from the humid-air property backend (EES 7.458 vs CoolProp AirH2O). Default run t_w_ex_set=35 C added per ees_import.md §8 (set-point of the GUI parametric study; value of the stored solution). No unit conversion needed (SI-C-Pa-J).
